spec.description:
Autex Frontier Raft - Trapezoid is an innovative acoustic ceiling beam system
designed for targeted sound absorption in open-plan spaces. Constructed
from 100% polyester fibre using scored and folded 12mm Cube material locked with
an extruded aluminium channel, Trapezoid creates a lightweight 3D acoustic
feature with an internal sound-dampening air gap. It easily fixes directly or
suspends from ceilings, delivering high acoustic performance across a wide
frequency range without the weight of solid timber or metal beams.
features:
Innovative scored and folded hollow 3D trapezoid profile (200mm wide x 137mm
deep)

Made from 100% polyester fibre containing a minimum of 60% recycled
PET
Group 1 fire rating compliant with AS ISO 9705 - 2003 and AS 5637.1
Sound absorption with internal air cavity achieving high NRC (0.75 - 0.95)
Lightweight alternative to solid wood or steel ceiling beams

Compatible with
Frontier channel and mounting clip suspension systems

Highly durable material
that will not bend, slump, or warp over time

Resistant to moisture, mould,
and mildew (ASTM G21-15 Growth Rating: 0)

Safe, non-toxic, non-allergenic,
and low-VOC emissions

install:
Plan ceiling layout
allowing recommended 300mm spacing between raft centres

Securely install
Frontier mounting clips or suspension track to structural ceiling

Slide
RAFNEXRT aluminium extrusion into the folded Trapezoid raft top channel

Align
Autex mounting clips with channel and turn 45 degrees to temporarily position
Adjust along length and twist clips 90 degrees to lock firmly in place

Fit
black extrusion end caps to ends for a neat aesthetic finish
selection_checklist:

for 137mm deep profile

Select raft length (1200mm or 2400mm) and calculate
pack quantities based on 300mm spacing

Choose colourway from Autex Cube solid
colour or Acoustic Timber printed finish range

Verify direct-fix or suspended
installation hardware requirement

Confirm local seismic bracing requirements
if applicable

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Frontier Raft -
Trapezoid is a 3D acoustic ceiling beam system formed from scored and
folded 12mm Cube polyester panels locking into an aluminium suspension channel.
Sized at 200mm wide by 137mm high in 1200mm or 2400mm lengths, its hollow
profile and internal air gap deliver high sound absorption (NRC 0.75 - 0.95)
across speech frequencies. Achieving NCC Group 1 fire compliance and
carbon-neutral certification with over 60% recycled PET content, it offers an
architecturally striking, lightweight alternative to solid timber baffles for
open-plan commercial, educational, and hospitality interiors.
